targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS deploys FROM cicd_pipelines WHERE type='DEPLOYMENT' AND result='SUCCESS' AND finished_date > DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 90 DAY)

SELECT ROUND(AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, c.authored_date, p.finished_date)) / 60, 2) AS hours FROM cicd_pipelines p JOIN cicd_pipeline_commits pc ON pc.pipeline_id = p.id JOIN commits c ON c.sha = pc.commit_sha WHERE p.type='DEPLOYMENT' AND p.result='SUCCESS' AND p.finished_date > DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 90 DAY)

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM issues i WHERE i.type='INCIDENT' AND i.created_date BETWEEN p.finished_date AND DATE_ADD(p.finished_date, INTERVAL 24 HOUR)) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*),0), 2) AS cfr FROM cicd_pipelines p WHERE p.type='DEPLOYMENT' AND p.finished_date > DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 90 DAY)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(lead_time_minutes)/60.0, 2) AS hours FROM issues WHERE type='INCIDENT' AND created_date > DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 90 DAY) AND resolution_date IS NOT NULL

SELECT DATE(FROM_DAYS(TO_DAYS(p.finished_date) - MOD(TO_DAYS(p.finished_date) - 2, 7))) AS time, COUNT(*) AS value FROM cicd_pipelines p WHERE p.type='DEPLOYMENT' AND p.finished_date > DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 26 WEEK) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT r.name AS repo, ROUND(AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, pr.created_date, pr.merged_date)), 2) AS mean_hours FROM pull_requests pr JOIN repos r ON r.id = pr.base_repo_id WHERE pr.merged_date > DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 90 DAY) GROUP BY r.name ORDER BY mean_hours DESC

SELECT a.user_name AS author, COUNT(c.sha) AS commits, SUM(c.additions) AS lines_added, SUM(c.deletions) AS lines_removed FROM accounts a LEFT JOIN commits c ON c.author_id = a.id AND c.authored_date > DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 90 DAY) GROUP BY a.user_name HAVING commits > 0 ORDER BY commits DESC LIMIT 25
